proposal.reason: Main change is SDK-2.3 compatibility in device-side BF16 intrinsic usage and conversion paths for core collective kernels (e.g., reduce/vector kernel code), which fits kernels. A separate, independently substantive set of the same BF16/API-guard updates is in symmetric-memory kernel paths (ce_kernel/sym_reduce), so symmetric review is also needed; enqueue/gin/header edits appear as supporting compatibility wiring rather than standalone policy/protocol changes in those modules.
